title: Fix notification tap navigating to Google search instead of user profile

requirements.text: Fix the notification item tap/click handler in the Notifications page so that tapping a notification navigates to the referenced user's in-app profile page instead of triggering a Google search for the username. The navigation must use the app's internal router (e.g., TanStack Router) to route to the correct profile route, and must not construct any external URL or href that would open a browser search.

quotes: When I tap it it brings up a Google search for that word whatever the user name is

acceptanceCriteria: Tapping a notification item navigates to the referenced user's profile page within the app.
No external browser navigation or Google search is triggered when tapping a notification.
The correct username/principal is passed to the profile route so the right profile loads.
Navigation works for all notification types that reference a user.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Use the existing TanStack Router navigation pattern already established in App.tsx.
